description: This file defines an interface for dispatching actions, including a template interface IDispatchType for generic elements and a specialization for void. It also declares an external interface IDispatch that inherits from IDispatchType<void> and provides an Identifier method. The file includes licensing information and references to other modules such as Module, Trace, and TextFragment.

classes.name: IDispatch
classes.description: An external interface inheriting from IDispatchType<void>, providing a method to get a string identifier.

classes.name: IDispatchType
classes.description: A template interface for dispatching elements of type ELEMENT, with a specialization for void.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Returns a string identifier for the dispatch object, based on its class name.
